name: write_section
label: Write section from papers
description: Write ONE manuscript section in LaTeX for `goal`, using only facts from passages of the listed papers. `papers` is ONE string of citekeys separated by spaces or commas (or an array of citekeys). Every factual sentence ends with \cite{key}; anything the papers do not support is left out or marked explicitly unverified. The section is verified as written with `verify` document mode and failures get one repair round. Returns the LaTeX, a summary, and the unresolved units. It never writes files: paste the returned LaTeX into the manuscript verbatim (rewriting invalidates its verification) and resolve any listed unresolved units.

papers.description: ONE string of citekeys separated by spaces or commas (never an array)

query.description: Focus: which passages of the papers to build the section from

max_words.description: Longest the section may be, in words
